definitions.explanation: One example among many; a single illustrative case. Used in writing and presentation to introduce a specific instance that demonstrates a broader pattern.

examples.japanese: これはほんの{一例|いちれい}にすぎない。
examples.english: This is just one example among many.

examples.japanese: {成功|せいこう}したケースの{一例|いちれい}として、{彼|かれ}の{会社|かいしゃ}が{紹介|しょうかい}された。
examples.english: As one example of a successful case, his company was introduced.

notes:
Compound of {一|いち} (one) + {例|れい} (example). Slightly more formal than just {例|れい}, with the nuance of "just one of many." Often used in writing to soften a single example into something representative rather than exhaustive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一例|いちれい}を{挙|あ}げる: to give an example
- {一例|いちれい}として: as one example
- ほんの{一例|いちれい}: just one example (often "merely one example among many")
- {一例|いちれい}にすぎない: is only one example

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {例|れい}: example — the everyday word, no "just one" nuance
- {具体例|ぐたいれい}: concrete example — emphasizes specificity
- {事例|じれい}: case (study); instance — used for documented examples in research/reports
